Woohoo!\pI hear people call me the ROCK SMASH
GUY, but I find that sort of degrading.\pI think I deserve a bit more respect,
like maybe the ROCK SMASH DUDE.\pWoohoo!\pAnyways, your POKéMON look pretty
strong.\pI like that!
Here, take this HIDDEN MACHINE!

That HM contains ROCK SMASH.\pIf you come across large boulders
that block your path…\pWell, use that HM move and smash
them right out of your way!\pYes, sir! Smash rocks aside, I say!
Woohoo!
Oh, yes, if you smash a rock, a POKéMON\ncould come flying out of hiding.\pWoohoo!
